name: numeric-conversion-test-6b3e1e5e00/invalid-int-as-byte-union-negative-255-p.bal
spec_references: ## Module-level declarations: Function definition — Supports required-params
reason: The case requires a runtime panic when an int|boolean holding -255 is cast to byte|boolean. Type casts, local declarations, required-parameter functions, calls and unary numeric minus are supported, with no restriction excluding union casts or their failure behavior. The out-of-range negative integer cannot satisfy byte or boolean, so the asserted cast failure is in scope.
test_design_notes: The @panic comment marks the expected runtime failure; the case does not assert a particular error message.
